title: 第一卷 第13章 洞房花烛天品功法第一卷 第14章 两女初见周皇惊麻了
slug: 自曝万嗣呈祥父皇给我疯狂赐婚
content_zh:
吱呀——
一声轻响，雕花木门应手而开。
门外的夜风与喧嚣，像是被一只无形的大手掐断，瞬间被关在身后。
眼前，只剩下一片浓得化不开的红。
红烛，红帐，红被。
空气里都飘着一股喜庆的甜香，暖得让人脸颊发烫。
赵辰安迈步而入，身后的木门自动合上，彻底隔绝了两个世界。
他的新娘，李青鸾，正端端正正地坐在床沿。
凤冠霞帔，红盖头垂落，遮住了她所有的神情，只留下一双交叠在膝上的素手。
那双手，指节因为用力而微微泛着白，泄露了主人此刻并不平静的内心。
赵辰安没有立刻上前，而是先走到桌边，不急不缓地拿起那杆备好的玉如意。
他一步步走向床前，靴底踩在红毯上。
没有发出半点声音，却让那道端坐的纤细身影，几不可察地绷紧了些。
一股清冽的幽香，丝丝缕缕地钻入鼻息。
玉如意探出，轻轻一挑。
那方绣着龙凤呈祥的红盖头，便无声地顺滑飘落。
烛火摇曳，一张绝美的容颜，就这么毫无征兆地撞进了赵辰安的眼里。
饶是见惯了皇城中各色美人，赵辰安的呼吸还是有那么一瞬间的停滞。
他见过的美人太多了，或妖娆，或清纯，或端庄。
但没有一个，能像眼前这张脸，让他心头猛地一跳。

不单单是五官的精致，更是一种矛盾又和谐的气质。
眉眼间自有将门之后的几分英气与凌厉，偏偏唇角和下颌的线条又柔和得不可思议。
两种截然不同的感觉，在她身上完美地交融。
李青鸾被他看得浑身不自在，长长的睫毛剧烈地颤动了几下，最终还是垂下了眼帘，不敢与他对视。
赵辰安回过神，倒了两杯酒，将其中一杯递了过去。
“喝了这杯合卺酒，你我，便是夫妻了。”
李青鸾抬起手，微凉的指尖碰到杯壁，让她瞬间清醒了几分。
两人手臂相交，各自饮尽杯中酒。
辛辣的酒液滑入喉咙，让她本就泛红的脸颊，更添了几分醉人的颜色。
放下酒杯，房间里再次陷入了死寂。
只有红烛燃烧时，偶尔发出的“噼啪”
轻响。
“嫁给我，委屈吗？”
赵辰安忽然开口，声音不大，却像一颗石子，砸破了这尴尬的平静。
他问得太直接了，没有半点铺垫。
李青鸾的身体明显一僵。
她似乎完全没料到，他会问出这样的话。
content_en:
Squeak——
There was a soft sound, and the carved wooden door opened.
The night wind and noise outside the door seemed to be cut off by a big invisible hand, and they were instantly shut behind him.
In front of him, there was only a red that was so thick that it couldn't be melted away.
Red candle, red tent, red quilt.
There is a festive sweet fragrance floating in the air, which is so warm that it makes your cheeks feel hot.
Zhao Chenan stepped in, and the wooden door behind him closed automatically, completely cutting off the two worlds.
His bride, Li Qingluan, was sitting upright on the edge of the bed.
The phoenix crown and the red hijab hanging down covered all her expressions, leaving only a pair of bare hands folded on her knees.
The knuckles of those hands were slightly white from exertion, revealing that the owner was not at peace at the moment.
Zhao Chenan did not step forward immediately, but walked to the table first and picked up the prepared jade Ruyi in a hurry.
He walked towards the bed step by step, the soles of his boots stepping on the red carpet.
Not a single sound was made, but the slender figure sitting upright tensed almost imperceptibly.
A crisp and refreshing fragrance penetrated into the nostrils.
Yu Ruyi reached out and picked it gently.
The red hijab embroidered with auspicious dragons and phoenixes fell silently and smoothly.
The candlelight flickered, and a beautiful face ran into Zhao Chenan's eyes without any warning.
Even though he was used to seeing all kinds of beauties in the imperial city, Zhao Chenan's breathing still stopped for a moment.
He has seen too many beauties, some are enchanting, some are pure, some are dignified.
But none of them could make his heart skip a beat like the face in front of him.
Not only the exquisite facial features, but also a contradictory and harmonious temperament.
There is a bit of heroism and fierceness between the eyebrows and eyes, but the lines of the corners of the lips and jaw are incredibly soft.
Two completely different feelings blended perfectly in her body.
Li Qingluan felt uncomfortable looking at him. His long eyelashes trembled violently several times, and finally he lowered his eyes, not daring to look at him.
Zhao Chenan came to his senses, poured two glasses of wine, and handed one over.
"After drinking this cup of combined wine, you and I will become husband and wife."
Li Qingluan raised her hand, and her cold fingertips touched the wall of the cup, which made her wake up for a moment.
The two of them crossed their arms and drank the wine from their glasses.
The spicy wine slid down her throat, adding an intoxicating color to her already red cheeks.
Putting down the wine glass, the room fell into dead silence again.
There is only the occasional "crack" when the red candle burns.
Sound softly.
"Are you aggrieved by marrying me?"
Zhao Chenan suddenly spoke, his voice was not loud, but it was like a stone, breaking the awkward calm.
He asked too directly, without any foreshadowing.
Li Qingluan's body visibly stiffened.
She didn't seem to expect that he would ask such a question.
